test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement and conclusion for pictorial drawing are given below. Determine the logical relationship between them.

Statement: Pictorial drawings are three-dimensional and provide a visual representation of an object.

Conclusion: Therefore, pictorial drawings are useful for describing the shape of a piece part or component.

options.text: The conclusion does not logically follow from the statement.
The conclusion is unrelated to the statement.
The conclusion logically follows from the statement.
The conclusion is partially supported by the statement.

solution:
The correct answer is __The conclusion logically follows from the statement.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement explains that pictorial drawings are three-dimensional and provide a visual representation of an object.
 
• This indicates their ability to effectively describe the shape of a piece part or component.
 
• The conclusion is a logical inference based on the information provided in the statement.
 
• Hence, the conclusion follows logically from the given statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Three-dimensional drawings:**
 
 
• They allow for better visualization of objects and components.
 
• They are used in engineering, design, and manufacturing fields.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used for creating prototypes and understanding spatial relationships.
 
• Helps in communication and collaboration within design teams.
